title: Quantifiers (Much, Many, A lot of)
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has aprendido a cuantificar recursos, dinero y tiempo de forma correcta.

stages.title: Cuantificadores: Much, Many, A lot of

parts.visual: Sustantivos Contables (se pueden contar: 1 laptop, 2 laptops): Usamos MANY (muchos), A FEW (unos pocos). Ej: We don't have MANY laptops. We have A FEW laptops.
parts.audio: Countable nouns are things you can count, like laptops. We use MANY and A FEW. For example: We don't have MANY laptops. We have A FEW laptops.

parts.visual:
Sustantivos Incontables (no se cuentan: money, time, information): Usamos MUCH (mucho), A LITTLE (un poco). Ej: We don't have MUCH time. We have A LITTLE money. 
A LOT OF (mucho/s) se usa para ambos (contables e incontables), casi siempre en oraciones afirmativas.
parts.audio: Uncountable nouns are things you cannot count directly, like money, time, and information. We use MUCH and A LITTLE. For example: We don't have MUCH time. We have A LITTLE money. A LOT OF can be used for both countable and uncountable nouns, mostly in affirmative sentences.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el cuantificador correcto para cada situación corporativa.

questions.question: We don't have ____ time to finish the project. (Tiempo es incontable).
questions.explanation: Para incontables en negativo se usa 'much'.

questions.question: How ____ employees work in the London branch? (Empleados son contables).
questions.explanation: Para preguntar por plurales contables se usa 'How many'.

questions.question: The company made ____ money last year. (Afirmativa, dinero es incontable).
questions.explanation: En afirmativas, es muy común usar 'a lot of' para ambos tipos.

questions.question: There are only ____ chairs in the meeting room. (Sillas son contables).
questions.explanation: 'A few' (unos pocos) se usa con plurales contables.

questions.question: I need ____ more information before making a decision. (Información es incontable).
questions.explanation: 'A little' (un poco) se usa con incontables. 'Information' siempre es incontable en inglés.

questions.question: How ____ does this software cost? (Pregunta sobre precio/dinero incontable).
questions.explanation: Para preguntar precio o cantidad incontable se usa 'How much'.

questions.question: He didn't make ____ sales this month. (Ventas son contables y plurales).
questions.explanation: Para negativos contables plurales se usa 'many'.

questions.question: We received ____ of applications for the job. (Muchas).
questions.explanation: La expresión completa es 'a lot of' (en la oración ya está el 'of', por lo que la opción es 'a lot').

questions.question: Can I give you ____ advice? (Consejo es incontable en inglés).
questions.explanation: Advice es incontable en inglés (no existe 'advices'), por lo que lleva 'a little' o 'some'.

questions.question: I only have ____ minutes before my next meeting. (Minutos son contables).
They spend too ____ money on marketing. (Dinero es incontable).
There are too ____ people in this elevator. (Personas son contables).
We had ____ problems with the server yesterday. (Afirmativa, plural contable).
Let's wait. We still have ____ time. (Tenemos un poco de tiempo).
questions.explanation: A little time = un poco de tiempo (suficiente).

questions.question: I don't have ____ experience in sales. (Experiencia es incontable).
questions.explanation: En negativo e incontable se usa 'much'.

questions.question: How ____ emails do you receive a day? (Correos son contables).
We have very ____ budget left for this project. (Presupuesto como dinero/masa es incontable, o aquí 'poco').
questions.explanation: Very little budget = muy poco presupuesto. (Few es para contables plurales).

questions.question: Just ____ corrections are needed on the report. (Solo unas pocas correcciones).
He has a lot ____ meetings today. (Completar la frase).
I don't drink ____ coffee. (Café como líquido es incontable).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe much, many, a lot of, a few, o a little.

questions.question: We don't have ____ time. (Incontable negativo)
How ____ employees are there? (Contable plural)
He has ____ ____ of money. (Mucho - afirmativa)
There are only ____ ____ chairs. (Unas pocas)
I need ____ ____ information. (Un poco - incontable)
How ____ does it cost? (Precio)
I only have ____ ____ minutes. (Unos pocos)
We had ____ ____ ____ problems. (Muchos - 3 palabras)
They spend too ____ money. (Demasiado - incontable)
There are too ____ people. (Demasiadas - contable)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We don't have much time to finish the project.
options: We don't have much time to finish the project.
We don't have many time to finish the project.
We have a little time to finish the project.
They don't have much time to finish the project.
questions.correct_answer: We don't have much time to finish the project.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: How many employees work in the London branch?
options: How many employees work in the London branch?
How much employees work in the London branch?
How many workers work in the London branch?
How many employees work in London?
questions.correct_answer: How many employees work in the London branch?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The company made a lot of money last year.
options: The company made a lot of money last year.
The company made much money last year.
The company earned a lot of money last year.
My company made a lot of money last year.
questions.correct_answer: The company made a lot of money last year.

questions.tts_text: There are only a few chairs in the meeting room.

There are a few chairs in the meeting room.

There are some chairs in the meeting room.
questions.correct_answer: There are only a few chairs in the meeting room.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I need a little more information.
options: I need a little more information.
I need a few more information.
She needs a little more information.
questions.correct_answer: I need a little more information.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: How much does this software cost?
options: How much does this software cost?

How many does this software cost?
questions.correct_answer: How much does this software cost?

options: They spend too much money on marketing.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: There are too many people in this elevator.
options: There are too many people in this elevator.

There are many people in this elevator.
